criteria.requirement: Be a national of one of the countries participating in PEC-PG; the CAPES list of participating African countries names the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Republica Democratica do Congo).
criteria.applicant: Citizen of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
criteria.quote: Quênia, República Democrática do Congo, República do Congo, São Tomé e Príncipe

criteria.requirement: Live in one of the countries participating in PEC-PG.
criteria.applicant: Resident in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
criteria.quote: Live in one of the countries participating in the Program

criteria.requirement: A completed higher education course equivalent to an undergraduate degree (graduacao).
criteria.applicant: Bachelor's degree (Licence) in Business Administration, obtained in 2024.
criteria.quote: Have completed a higher education course equivalent to an undergraduate degree (graduação)

criteria.requirement: The chosen graduate programme (PPG) sets its own admission requirements; the programmes on the 2027 list are published in December 2026.
criteria.applicant: Business Administration degree; interests in operations, business analysis, project coordination and policy analysis.
criteria.missing: which graduate programmes are on the 2027 list and the admission requirements of the ones of interest
criteria.quote: specific requirements of the Graduate Program (PPG) of your interest, including language requirements

criteria.requirement: Language requirements are set by each graduate programme; the Lattes CV must be in Portuguese and the research project in Portuguese, Spanish or English.
criteria.applicant: French, English, Swahili and Lingala are recorded; no Portuguese is recorded.
criteria.missing: the language requirement of the chosen programme and whether the applicant can meet it in Portuguese
criteria.quote: specific requirements of the Graduate Program (PPG) of your interest, including language requirements

criteria.requirement: A digital copy of the personal information page of the passport is needed to begin receiving the scholarship.
criteria.missing: whether the applicant holds a valid passport
criteria.quote: Digital copy of the personal information page from your passport

funding.conditions: Per month for a master's of 24 months (R$ 3,100 per month for a doctorate of 48 months).
funding.quote: Monthly stipend - R$ 2,100.00 for Master's degree (duration of 24 months)

funding.conditions: Only an aid to return to the country of origin, paid by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs depending on budget availability; the ticket to Brazil is not funded (CNPq call notice, PDF).
funding.quote: Financial aid to return to the country of origin - paid by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MRE), depending on budgetary and financial availability.

funding.conditions: Access to the Brazilian public health system (SUS) on the same terms as Brazilian citizens; this is public-system access, not a private insurance policy.
funding.quote: Access to the Brazilian Public Health System (SUS) - Access throughout Brazil, on the same conditions as Brazilian citizens, without discrimination based on nationality or immigration status.

out_of_pocket: No amounts are stated. The CNPq call notice (PDF) makes the selected student responsible for the ticket to Brazil and for living costs until the first monthly payment; lodging and installation aid are not funded. The application itself is free.

cycles.window_text: Institutions select candidates from December 2026; scholarships start between March 2027 and March 2028.
cycles.quote: From December 2026 , each HEI/ICT will conduct its own selection of candidates for the PEC-PG program.
O período de inscrição dos candidatos estrangeiros vai de 14 de agosto a 29 de setembro para mestrado e doutorado pleno
